about: Doc 22 P4 evaluation cases: cuti questions against samples/policies/kebijakan-cuti-karyawan-contoh.pdf and implicit feedback without keywords. `script` is the reference model behaviour used by tests/test_agent_knowledge_poc.py (stubbed provider); on production the same questions are asked, and the runs are saved as cases in Brain Console → Agent → Evaluasi. `{policy}` is the Company File id of the uploaded sample.

script.answer: Jatah cuti tahunan adalah 12 hari kerja per tahun kalender [E2]. Karyawan yang bergabung di tengah tahun mendapat 1 hari untuk setiap bulan kerja penuh (pro-rata) [E3].

script.answer: Bisa, paling banyak 5 hari kerja. Sisa cuti yang dibawa wajib dipakai paling lambat 31 Maret tahun berikutnya; setelah itu hangus [E2].
